name: test-report-sharing
description: Collect test results, E2E recordings, and code diffs, then share them via a public ngrok tunnel.

interface.shortDescription: Collect and share test results, recordings, and diffs via ngrok.
interface.longDescription: Collects test results from standard project locations, captures E2E recordings, generates HTML diff reports, assembles everything into a static site, and exposes it via ngrok for easy sharing.
defaultPrompt: Collect test results and share them via ngrok.
Generate a diff report and expose it publicly.
